    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">oracle中date类型在mybatis中查询时遇到的坑</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="背景">背景</h1>
<p>最近生产遇到个问题，大致也是遵从墨菲定律吧，你感觉会出问题的地方，可能就真会出问题。oracle我一直觉得过于复杂，从来没有系统学习过。最近遇到的问题就和date这种类型的列有关系，有个表中的记录大概这样：2024-05-13 00:00:00.000 ，然后类型是date，我还以为这种类型只包含年月日，结果发现其包含了7个字段：世纪、年、月、日、时、分、秒。另外，我还以为这个类型和时区有关系，结果经过这两天的补课，发现这个类型是不包含任何的时区信息的。</p>
<p>简单说下遇到的问题吧，oracle里有一个考勤结果表，主要包含了oa账号、date、考勤结果，之前是有一个数据库定时任务，每天早上6点会调用一个存储过程，存储过程里会往这个表里插入数据。</p>
<p>由于不好调试，且这个存储过程有点bug，我就用xxljob+java重新实现了一下，初版是ai写的，我自己调整了部分代码。</p>
<p>我的java实现大概如下：</p>
<p>为了支持幂等（xxljob重复运行），会检查某个用户在某一天是否已经有记录了，有记录就先删掉，没记录就插入（典型的先删再加）。</p>
<p>结果不记得当时是本地测试不充分还是怎么的，反正就上线了，上线后，xxljob一跑，结果发现存储过程那边写入的记录没删掉，然后重新插入了一条一样的，导致同一个用户同一天有了多条记录，导致app侧报错。</p>
<h1 id="问题代码">问题代码</h1>
<h2 id="数据库表">数据库表</h2>
<p>我们有个这个表：T_ATTENDANCE_RESULT_DAY</p>
<p>核心字段我精简下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">"OA_ACCOUNT" VARCHAR2(20),  oa账号
"TERM" DATE类型, 考勤日期
</code></pre>
<p>原存储过程写入的数据如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT tard.OA_ACCOUNT ,term FROM T_ATTENDANCE_RESULT_DAY tard WHERE tard.OA_ACCOUNT = 'zhangsan' AND tard.TERM = DATE '2026-09-13'

OA_ACCOUNT|TERM                   |
----------+-----------------------+
zhangsan  |2026-09-13 00:00:00.000|
</code></pre>
<h2 id="mybatis">mybatis</h2>
<p>注意啊，下面我传的是个LocalDate：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">int deleteByBusinessKey(@Param("oaAccount") String oaAccount,
                        @Param("term") LocalDate term);
</code></pre>
<p>下面sql中，term的jdbcType是TIMESTAMP：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;delete id="deleteByBusinessKey"&gt;
    delete from t_attendance_result_day
     where oa_account = #{oaAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
       and term = #{term,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
&lt;/delete&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>传值:</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@PostMapping(path = "/testDelete")
@DS("attendance")
@Operation(summary = "testDelete", tags = "考勤结果分析处理")
public Message&lt;TAttendanceResultDay&gt; testDelete() {
    DateTimeFormatter formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd");
    LocalDate localDate = LocalDate.parse("2026-09-13", formatter);
    int i = tAttendanceResultDayMapper.deleteByBusinessKey("zhangsan", localDate);
    System.out.println(i);

    return successResponse();
}
</code></pre>
<p>再交代下服务器端oracle版本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT * FROM v$version;
Oracle Database 11g Enterprise Edition Release 11.2.0.4.0 - 64bit Production
</code></pre>
<p>java这边的版本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">spring boot 2.7.16 
jdk8
&lt;dependency&gt;
    &lt;groupId&gt;com.oracle.database.jdbc&lt;/groupId&gt;
    &lt;artifactId&gt;ojdbc8&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;version&gt;23.2.0.0&lt;/version&gt;
    &lt;scope&gt;compile&lt;/scope&gt;
&lt;/dependency&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>调这个接口试试：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">09-13 13:19:33.621 [http-nio-8085-exec-7] DEBUG [42c6843bd13e4a3b] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey ==&gt;  Preparing: delete from t_attendance_result_day where oa_account = ? and term = ? [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 13:19:38.440 [http-nio-8085-exec-7] DEBUG [42c6843bd13e4a3b] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey ==&gt; Parameters: zhangsan(String), 2026-09-13(LocalDate) [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 13:19:38.454 [http-nio-8085-exec-7] DEBUG [42c6843bd13e4a3b] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey &lt;==    Updates: 0 [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
</code></pre>
<p>可以发现，影响的行为0行，没删掉。</p>
<h1 id="原因分析">原因分析</h1>
<h2 id="抓包">抓包</h2>
<p>我其实先抓了个网络包，发现看不到东西，date这种类型的参数，可能不是字符串，所以看不到：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913132455858.png" alt="image-20260913132455858" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="debug">debug</h2>
<p>我发现，设置参数主要在这个部分：org.apache.ibatis.executor.SimpleExecutor#doUpdate</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913132730690.png" alt="image-20260913132730690" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913132758601.png" alt="image-20260913132758601" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913133005332.png" alt="image-20260913133005332" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这个ParameterHandler是个接口，就包含两方法：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">public interface ParameterHandler {

  Object getParameterObject();

  void setParameters(PreparedStatement ps) throws SQLException;

}
</code></pre>
<p>我的项目里就两个实现：</p>
<p>一个是mybatis包里的org.apache.ibatis.scripting.defaults.DefaultParameterHandler</p>
<p>另一个是mybatis-plus里的：com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.MybatisParameterHandler</p>
<p>我这边走的是mybatis-plus。</p>
<p>方法的实现，主要就是获取sql中，看看需要绑定的参数列表，然后遍历，最终调用preparedStatement中的各种set方法去设置值。</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913133441658.png" alt="image-20260913133441658" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913133610219.png" alt="image-20260913133610219" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在设置值之前，需要先根据参数的class（如“zhansgan”的class是java.lang.String）和xml中指定的jdbcType，来找到一个handler：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913133919313.png" alt="image-20260913133919313" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>比如上图找到的是StringTypeHandler。然后开始调用handler的方法：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">handler.setParameter(ps, i, parameter, jdbcType);
</code></pre>
<p>org.apache.ibatis.type.StringTypeHandler这个handler中，设置值，就是调用java.sql.PreparedStatement#setString</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913134038760.png" alt="image-20260913134038760" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>最终就会调用到下面oracle驱动的部分：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913134310478.png" alt="image-20260913134310478" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="检查term参数是如何被设置">检查term参数是如何被设置</h2>
<p>根据参数类型(LocalDate)和jdbcType(TIMESTAMP)，最终的handler为：</p>
<p>org.apache.ibatis.type.LocalDateTypeHandler</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913134559295.png" alt="image-20260913134559295" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这个handler中是调用preparedStatement的setObject方法来设置参数的：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913134749891.png" alt="image-20260913134749891" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="oracle驱动部分">oracle驱动部分</h3>
<p>oracle中的setObject方法也是继续调用底层oracle.jdbc.driver.T4CPreparedStatement的setObject方法</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913134905987.png" alt="image-20260913134905987" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>然后根据LocalDate类型计算了一个sqlType为93：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913135057162.png" alt="image-20260913135057162" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这边会把LocalDate转成oracle自己的一个oracle.sql.TIMESTAMP类型：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913135200373.png" alt="image-20260913135200373" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913135300209.png" alt="image-20260913135300209" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>转换器代码如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">        CONVERTERS.put(new Key(LocalDate.class, TIMESTAMP.class), new JavaToJavaConverter&lt;LocalDate, TIMESTAMP&gt;() {
            protected TIMESTAMP convert(LocalDate src, OracleConnection conn, Object srcExtra, Object targetExtra) throws Exception {
                return new TIMESTAMP(src); --就是这里
            }
        });

</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-java">public TIMESTAMP(LocalDate ld) {
    super(toBytes(ld));
}
public static byte[] toBytes(LocalDate ld) {
    return ld == null ? null : toBytes(ld.atTime(12, 0, 0)); -- 这里，把传入的LocalDate设置了中午12点！
}
</code></pre>
<p>找到问题了，虽然传入的是日期2026-09-13，实际最终变成了:</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">2026-09-13 12:00:00
</code></pre>
<p>那当然是删不掉了。</p>
<p>另外，这里会把这个日期，转换成byte数组：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913135906533.png" alt="image-20260913135906533" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如2026年，result[0]就是2026/100 + 100 = 120，result[1]就是2026%100 + 100，就是126：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913135743552.png" alt="image-20260913135743552" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>其实拿这个16进制数组，可以去wireshark的抓包中找到对应的数据了：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913140145836.png" alt="image-20260913140145836" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="如何修改">如何修改</h2>
<p>那找到问题了，接下来就修改一下，看起来是传入了LocalDate导致的问题，那我们mapper这里传LocalDateTime吧。</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">&lt;delete id="deleteByBusinessKey"&gt;
    delete from t_attendance_result_day
     where oa_account = #{oaAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
       and term = #{term,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
&lt;/delete&gt;

        
int deleteByBusinessKey(@Param("oaAccount") String oaAccount,
                            @Param("term") LocalDateTime term);


@PostMapping(path = "/testDelete")
@DS("attendance")
@Operation(summary = "testDelete", tags = "考勤结果分析处理")
public Message&lt;TAttendanceResultDay&gt; testDelete() {
    DateTimeFormatter formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd");
    LocalDate localDate = LocalDate.parse("2026-09-13", formatter);
    LocalDateTime localDateTime = localDate.atStartOfDay();
    int i = tAttendanceResultDayMapper.deleteByBusinessKey("zhangsan", localDateTime);
    System.out.println(i);

    return successResponse();
}
</code></pre>
<p>修改后，重新观察，发现最终在oracle中还是会转换，这次是从LocalDateTime转TIMESTAMP：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913141139052.png" alt="image-20260913141139052" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>现在看着传的没问题了：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913141228588.png" alt="image-20260913141228588" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>结果：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">09-13 14:12:46.288 [oaxdb housekeeper] WARN  [] com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool oaxdb - Thread starvation or clock leap detected (housekeeper delta=50s394ms603µs500ns). [HikariPool.java:788]
09-13 14:12:46.289 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [dbbc18a0db9b4972] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey ==&gt; Parameters: zhangsan(String), 2026-09-13T00:00(LocalDateTime) [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 14:12:46.305 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [dbbc18a0db9b4972] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey &lt;==    Updates: 0 [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
</code></pre>
<p>还是没删除掉！</p>
<p>后面又简单尝试了下别的，还是没解决，只能让ai帮我看了。</p>
<h1 id="ai救场">ai救场</h1>
<p>把这个问题的上下文丢给了ai，我的是glm 5.3，吭哧吭哧干了十几分钟，出结果了。</p>
<p>我好好学习了下它的思路，另外，也感叹下，现在真就是干不过ai了。</p>
<p>ai从我的代码库里找到了数据库连接，账号密码啥的，自己写了个java类，把问题给复现了。</p>
<p>复现后，使用了一个dump函数查看发到数据库服务器端的数据到底是啥。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">比如下面的sql，dump(term)就可以查看到oracle中该字段的实际内容：
SELECT dump(term),term FROM T_ATTENDANCE_RESULT_DAY tard WHERE tard.OA_ACCOUNT = 'zhangsan' AND tard.TERM = DATE '2026-09-13'

DUMP(TERM)                      |TERM                   |
--------------------------------+-----------------------+
Typ=12 Len=7: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1|2026-09-13 00:00:00.000|
</code></pre>
<p>可以看到，这列在数据库侧的实际存储字节是：Typ=12 Len=7: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1</p>
<p>那么，我们这边的mybatis中调用oracle驱动，最终传给数据库服务器的是啥呢？</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">    &lt;select id="selectDump" resultType="java.lang.String"&gt;
        select dump(#{term,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})   as termDump  from dual
    &lt;/select&gt;


</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-java">String selectDump(@Param("term") LocalDateTime term);

    @PostMapping(path = "/testDelete")
    @DS("attendance")
    @Operation(summary = "testDelete", tags = "考勤结果分析处理")
    public Message&lt;TAttendanceResultDay&gt; testDelete() {
        DateTimeFormatter formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd");
        LocalDate localDate = LocalDate.parse("2026-09-13", formatter);
        LocalDateTime localDateTime = localDate.atStartOfDay();

        String string = tAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump(localDateTime);
        System.out.println(string);
    }
</code></pre>
<p>运行一下，结果如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">09-13 14:27:56.407 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [98117dea9df645d3] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump ==&gt;  Preparing: select dump(?) as termDump from dual [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 14:28:03.425 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [98117dea9df645d3] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump ==&gt; Parameters: 2026-09-13T00:00(LocalDateTime) [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 14:28:03.470 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [98117dea9df645d3] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump &lt;==      Total: 1 [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
Typ=180 Len=11: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1,0,0,0,0
</code></pre>
<p>这边发现，传过去的内容好像和数据库那边查出来的不一样：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Typ=180 Len=11: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1,0,0,0,0  这边传过去的
vs
Typ=12 Len=7: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1   数据库查出来的
</code></pre>
<p>做等值查询的时候，所以就匹配不到了。</p>
<h2 id="如何修改-1">如何修改</h2>
<p>按照ai建议，修改如下：</p>
<p>使用cast函数：Oracle CAST 是一个‌<strong>显式数据类型转换函数</strong>‌，用于将一个值从一种数据类型转换为另一种兼容的数据类型</p>
<p>我们也写了个xml查询发过去的内容：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;select id="selectDump" resultType="java.lang.String"&gt;
    select dump(cast(#{term,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as date))   as termDump  from dual
&lt;/select&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>运行一下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">09-13 14:49:28.984 [http-nio-8085-exec-2] DEBUG [a9cccd9a74aa435c] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump ==&gt;  Preparing: select dump(cast(? as date)) as termDump from dual [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 14:49:28.985 [http-nio-8085-exec-2] DEBUG [a9cccd9a74aa435c] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump ==&gt; Parameters: 2026-09-13T00:00(LocalDateTime) [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 14:49:28.999 [http-nio-8085-exec-2] DEBUG [a9cccd9a74aa435c] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump &lt;==      Total: 1 [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
Typ=13 Len=8: 234,7,9,13,0,0,0,0


</code></pre>
<p>看到内容是：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Typ=13 Len=8: 234,7,9,13,0,0,0,0
</code></pre>
<p>和服务端的好像也不同：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">SELECT dump(term) FROM T_ATTENDANCE_RESULT_DAY tard WHERE tard.OA_ACCOUNT = 'zhangsan' AND tard.TERM = DATE '2026-09-13'
Typ=12 Len=7: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1 
</code></pre>
<p>我们实际看看效果：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;delete id="deleteByBusinessKey"&gt;
    delete from t_attendance_result_day
     where oa_account = #{oaAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
       and term = cast(#{term,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as date)
&lt;/delete&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>看下面日志，真他么删掉了啊：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">09-13 14:54:00.726 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [6fa9425af3924a57] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump ==&gt;  Preparing: select dump(cast(? as date)) as termDump from dual [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 14:54:00.834 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [6fa9425af3924a57] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump ==&gt; Parameters: 2026-09-13T00:00(LocalDateTime) [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 14:54:00.882 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [6fa9425af3924a57] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump &lt;==      Total: 1 [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
Typ=13 Len=8: 234,7,9,13,0,0,0,0

09-13 14:54:00.883 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [6fa9425af3924a57] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey ==&gt;  Preparing: delete from t_attendance_result_day where oa_account = ? and term = cast(? as date) [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 14:54:00.884 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [6fa9425af3924a57] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey ==&gt; Parameters: zhangsan(String), 2026-09-13T00:00(LocalDateTime) [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 14:54:00.899 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [6fa9425af3924a57] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey &lt;==    Updates: 1 [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
</code></pre>
<p>那这啥意思呢，我们传过去的是：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Typ=13 Len=8: 234,7,9,13,0,0,0,0
</code></pre>
<p>服务端是：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Typ=12 Len=7: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1 
</code></pre>
<p>这也不相等啊。</p>
<p>ai跟我说：</p>
<p>13是属于外部格式，外部格式（13）是小端直接编码：<code>234,7</code> → 234+7×256 = <strong>2026</strong> 年。</p>
<h2 id="直接传localdatetime为啥不行">直接传localDateTime为啥不行</h2>
<p>大哥又给我说了，是服务端端版本是oracle 11g，这个版本对于目前使用的java驱动来说，太低了。</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;com.oracle.database.jdbc&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;ojdbc8&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;version&gt;23.2.0.0&lt;/version&gt;
        &lt;scope&gt;compile&lt;/scope&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;

</code></pre>
<p>支持的版本范围是：</p>
<p><a href="https://www.oracle.com/database/technologies/faq-jdbc.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.oracle.com/database/technologies/faq-jdbc.html</a></p>
<p>最低支持的都是19.x版本，连12.x都不支持，别提11.x了</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913150301593.png" alt="image-20260913150301593" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>我当时是由于一个新增需求，才增加了这个java服务读这个oracle库，但为什么选了一个这么高的版本呢，也就几个月前的事，却是一点想不起来了。可能也没想那么多吧。</p>
<h2 id="换回老版本的oracle驱动">换回老版本的oracle驱动</h2>
<p>换成老版本：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;com.oracle&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;ojdbc6&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;version&gt;11.2.0.3&lt;/version&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;

</code></pre>
<p>xml换回来；</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">    &lt;select id="selectDump" resultType="java.lang.String"&gt;
        select dump(#{term,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})   as termDump  from dual
    &lt;/select&gt;

</code></pre>
<p>数据加回来，重试，直接就报错了，原来是ojdbc6根本不认识LocalDateTime这类类型：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260913152944072.png" alt="image-20260913152944072" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这下，看来我当时选择了高版本的ojdbc8就是这个原因了。只是没考虑到这次遇到的新问题。</p>
<h2 id="换到21900">换到21.9.0.0</h2>
<p>ai大哥让我改回一个稍微老点的版本，21.X，我挑了一个：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">    &lt;!-- Source: https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.oracle.database.jdbc/ojdbc8 --&gt;  
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;com.oracle.database.jdbc&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;ojdbc8&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;version&gt;21.9.0.0&lt;/version&gt;
        &lt;scope&gt;compile&lt;/scope&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;!-- Source: https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.oracle.database.nls/orai18n --&gt;
    &lt;dependency&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;com.oracle.database.nls&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;orai18n&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;version&gt;21.9.0.0&lt;/version&gt;
        &lt;scope&gt;compile&lt;/scope&gt;
    &lt;/dependency&gt;
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-shell">09-13 15:36:09.340 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [1e8aa02a5a694076] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump ==&gt;  Preparing: select dump(?) as termDump from dual [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 15:36:10.444 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [1e8aa02a5a694076] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump ==&gt; Parameters: 2026-09-13T00:00(LocalDateTime) [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 15:36:10.480 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [1e8aa02a5a694076] c.h.p.mapper.TAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump &lt;==      Total: 1 [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
Typ=180 Len=7: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1

09-13 15:36:11.702 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [1e8aa02a5a694076] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey ==&gt;  Preparing: delete from t_attendance_result_day where oa_account = ? and term = ? [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 15:36:13.443 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [1e8aa02a5a694076] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey ==&gt; Parameters: zhangsan(String), 2026-09-13T00:00(LocalDateTime) [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
09-13 15:36:13.458 [http-nio-8085-exec-1] DEBUG [1e8aa02a5a694076] c.h.p.m.T.deleteByBusinessKey &lt;==    Updates: 1 [BaseJdbcLogger.java:137]
</code></pre>
<p>换回21.9.0.0版本后，发现dump内容变成了：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Typ=180 Len=7: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1
</code></pre>
<p>和最早的23.x版本，确实不同了：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">Typ=180 Len=11: 120,126,9,13,1,1,1,0,0,0,0
</code></pre>
<h1 id="无法查询问题--最终可行的方案">无法查询问题--最终可行的方案</h1>
<h2 id="换成21900版本">换成21.9.0.0版本</h2>
<p>下面这样就可以：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">int deleteByBusinessKey(@Param("oaAccount") String oaAccount,
                            @Param("term") LocalDateTime term);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-xml">    &lt;delete id="deleteByBusinessKey"&gt;
        delete from t_attendance_result_day
         where oa_account = #{oaAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
           and term = #{term,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
    &lt;/delete&gt;

</code></pre>
<h2 id="保持23x版本">保持23.x版本</h2>
<h3 id="方法1">方法1</h3>
<p>用cast方式，</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">int deleteByBusinessKey(@Param("oaAccount") String oaAccount,
                            @Param("term") LocalDateTime term);
&lt;delete id="deleteByBusinessKey"&gt;
    delete from t_attendance_result_day
     where oa_account = #{oaAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
       and term = cast(#{term,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as date)
&lt;/delete&gt;
</code></pre>
<h3 id="方法2">方法2</h3>
<pre><code class="language-xml">    &lt;delete id="deleteByBusinessKey"&gt;
        delete from t_attendance_result_day
         where oa_account = #{oaAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
           and term = to_date(#{term,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
    &lt;/delete&gt;

int deleteByBusinessKey(@Param("oaAccount") String oaAccount,
                            @Param("term") String term);
</code></pre>
<p>这个就传字符串，最保险。再结合版本换成21.9，应该是最稳妥的。</p>
<h3 id="方法3">方法3</h3>
<pre><code class="language-xml">动态拼sql:
&lt;delete id="deleteByBusinessKey"&gt;
        delete from t_attendance_result_day
         where oa_account = #{oaAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
           and term = timestamp '${term}'
&lt;/delete&gt;

int deleteByBusinessKey(@Param("oaAccount") String oaAccount,
                            @Param("term") String term);
int i = tAttendanceResultDayMapper.deleteByBusinessKey("zhangsan", "2026-09-13 00:00:00");


下面这样写不行，必须动态拼sql才行：
&lt;delete id="deleteByBusinessKey"&gt;
    delete from t_attendance_result_day
     where oa_account = #{oaAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
       and term = timestamp #{term}
&lt;/delete&gt;
</code></pre>
<h1 id="插入问题">插入问题</h1>
<p>其实insert也会有问题，之前这个term字段都是定义成LocalDate的。插入的时候，比如赋值为:</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">    TAttendanceResultDay day = new TAttendanceResultDay();
    day.setTerm(LocalDate.now());
    day.setOaAccount("demo");
    tAttendanceResultDayMapper.insert(day);
</code></pre>
<p>就像前面说的那样，LocalDate会被oracle驱动转换为它自己的TIMESTAMP，转的时候，就变成了这一天的12点。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">2026-09-13 12:00:00.000
</code></pre>
<p>把字段类型弄成LocalDateTime就行了。</p>
<h1 id="一个坑点">一个坑点</h1>
<pre><code class="language-java">TAttendanceResultDay day = new TAttendanceResultDay();
LocalDateTime now = LocalDateTime.now();
day.setTerm(now);
day.setOaAccount("demo");
day.setBadge("001140");
tAttendanceResultDayMapper.insert(day);
执行完上面的插入后，比如now是：2026-09-13T16:19:16.389，但最终在数据库是这样的: 2026-09-13 16:19:16.000，没有最后的毫秒部分。
    
String string = tAttendanceResultDayMapper.selectDump(now);
System.out.println(string); -- Typ=180 Len=11: 120,126,9,13,17,20,17,23,47,171,64


但是这边等值匹配的时候，是带了毫秒的，依然会删不掉：
int i = tAttendanceResultDayMapper.deleteByBusinessKey("demo", now, "001140");
System.out.println(i);
</code></pre>
<h1 id="总结">总结</h1>
<p>看来看去，还是字符串格式最好，少了好多坑。</p>
<p>用这种算了：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">    &lt;delete id="deleteByBusinessKey"&gt;
        delete from t_attendance_result_day
         where oa_account = #{oaAccount,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
           and term = to_date(#{term,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')
    &lt;/delete&gt;

int deleteByBusinessKey(@Param("oaAccount") String oaAccount,
                            @Param("term") String term);
</code></pre>
<h1 id="参考">参考</h1>
<p>插入示例：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">INSERT INTO your_table_name (date_column) VALUES (TO_DATE('2024-05-13', 'YYYY-MM-DD'));
或者：
INSERT INTO your_table_name (date_column) VALUES (DATE '2024-05-13');  
</code></pre>
<p>查询时怎么查：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">select * from your_table_name where to_char(date_column,'yyyy-mm-dd') = '2024-05-13';  这个走不了索引
或者
select * from your_table_name where date_column = date '2024-05-13';
或者
select * from your_table_name where date_column = timestamp '2024-05-13 00:00:00';
或者
select * from your_table_name where date_column = to_date('2024-05-13','yyyy-mm-dd') 

select * from your_table_name where date_column &gt;= to_date('2024-05-13','yyyy-mm-dd') and update_time &lt; to_date('2024-05-14','yyyy-mm-dd');
</code></pre>
